Name: SH's Wild Critter Tweaks
Author: plurffle
Description:
With the creation of my other Wild Animals mod, I've always wanted to make a companion mod to it that edits most (if not all) of the other animal/critter sprites in the vanilla game to better match own sprites from my animal mod. I wanted to try a mix between ConcernedApe's style and my own, so I hope it fits fine in-game! ♡ This mod concept has always been in the back of my mind for the past year or so, but it's always felt a little intimidating with how much I couldn't help but want to do, but here we are now, [i]finally[/i].

This mod edits [i]most[/i] of the animals and creatures sprites in-game, all configurable with a randomized option to have any color/species variants showing up in your playthrough ([i][size=1]and if you're using the "Randomized" setting, some animals have a few secret variants[/size][/i]).

The mod is not fully complete however, but most animals have been accounted for.



[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]

[b]Q: How to install this mod?[/b]
[b]A:[/b]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Unzip the zip file.
3. Drop the extracted folder in your mods folder.

[b]Q: I experienced a bug! What should I do?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Please do read the rest of the FAQ here in case there is an answer already provided and to also check the main page/Comments section of the mod in case I have listed the bug as a "known issue". If neither of them has the solution, feel free to comment the bug in the Comments sections or over in the Bugs section.

[b]Q: Is this mod compatible with other mods?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Should be compatible with any mod, yes, [b]unless [/b]you have other mods that change the exact same assets as here. This mod has everything configurable however, so you can pick and choose which ones you want enabled in your game.

[b]Q: Does this mod cause lag?[/b]
[b]A:[/b] It shouldn't, so, nope. This mod simply edits pre-existing sprites in-game (which are randomized by default everyday, but you can also edit that in the config) and this doesn't add anything new (my Wild Critter Tweaks mod [b]does not[/b] work like my Wild Animals mod at all).

[b]Q: Will you be making sprite edits for ____________?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Unless I've already listed them down [i]or[/i] they're [b]not[/b] a modded animal/character, [i]probably [/i]not. I will also [b]not [/b]be creating barn/coop animal sprite replacements because there's a lot of mods that do just that and I just really like using them already (EDIT: I have a couple of farm animal sprite replacements up in my profile-).
